'''Grand Galaxy Holo-Park''' was a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] entertainment in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It displayed landscapes from the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="TJoY" />
